faq.q: Will it really be actual size?
faq.a: Yes. Everything is stored in millimetres. After a one-time calibration with a bank or ID card, the editor draws your lid at real size, and the PDF prints at exact physical dimensions.

faq.q: How do I know my printout is right?
faq.a: Every page has a ruler that must measure exactly 100 mm. Print at 100% / Actual size, not "Fit to page", and check it with a real ruler.

faq.q: My MacBook lid is bigger than my paper.
faq.a: The PDF tiles the lid across several A4 or Letter sheets with overlap strips and crosshairs so you can tape them together precisely.
No. Your layouts save on this device and you can share a link. Sign in with Google to keep them together in your collection; cloud saves and buying come later.

faq.q: Can I use photos of my own stickers?
faq.a: Yes. Upload or take a photo, remove the background, then set the real size by typing it, picking a preset, or marking a card or coin in the photo.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data PeelPlan collects, why, how long we keep it, and your rights under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (PDPA).

p: When you sign in with Google: the name, email and profile picture Google shares with us.
During first-time setup: your display name, birth date and, if you open a shop, the shop name, owner name, product types and description.
Your sticker layouts, uploaded sticker images and screen calibration are currently stored only in your browser, not on our servers.
When you buy from a shop: your shipping address and phone number, the items, totals and order status, any note you write, and the image of the PromptPay transfer slip you upload.
When you chat with a shop: the messages and images you send, and any report you file about a conversation.
If you run a shop: your storefront details, products, PromptPay number and account name, and your shop's links to other platforms.

Visit statistics, without cookies: the page you open (its address without anything after '?', and with order and chat ids removed), the site language, the domain of the website that linked to us, your device type (phone, tablet or computer, from the screen width) and a random visit ID that exists only in that browser tab and is gone when you close it. We do not store your IP address, use tracking cookies or fingerprinting, or use third-party analytics, and we don't link these statistics to your account.
When you send feedback or report a problem: your message, the page you sent it from, your device type and, only if you give it, an email address we use only to reply to you.
To verify you and run your account.
To save and reopen your layouts.
To check minimum age: users must be 13 or older; shop owners 20 or older under the Thai Civil and Commercial Code.
To create a shop page if you sign up as a shop.
To pass your order to the shop you bought from so it can confirm your payment and ship to you, and to let you and the shop talk about it.
To look into reports of fraud, abuse or infringing listings, and to keep a record in case of a dispute.
To count visits and see which pages people use so we can improve the site, and to read, fix and answer the problems and suggestions you send us.
Performance of our service contract (Section 24(3)) for your account and layouts.
Your consent (Section 19) for anything not needed to provide the service; you can withdraw it at any time.
Where the law requires it, minors under 20 need a guardian's consent.

Our legitimate interest (Section 24(5)) in running and improving the site, for cookieless visit statistics and the feedback you choose to send. If your browser sends a Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control signal, we don't record your visits at all.
We do not sell your data.
We use Google for sign-in and Supabase to store accounts once the service goes live. They may store data on servers outside Thailand; we ensure adequate safeguards under Sections 28 and 29.
Your shipping address, phone number and payment slip are shared only with the shop you order from, so it can check your payment and send your order. Other shops and other users cannot see them.
The shop receives that information as an independent business and must use it only to fulfil your order. Shops never see your email address or birth date.
PeelPlan does not receive your payment. Your bank or e-wallet processes the PromptPay transfer under its own privacy policy.
Account data is kept while you use the service and deleted within 30 days of a deletion request, unless the law requires longer.
Data in your browser can be removed by you at any time from your collection or browser settings.

Orders, including the shipping address and payment slip, are kept for 1 year after the order is completed or cancelled, so either side can raise a dispute, and then deleted. Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically after a few days.
Chat messages and images are kept until you or the shop delete the account. Reports are kept as long as needed to deal with them.
Visit statistics are deleted automatically after 13 months. Feedback messages are kept for up to 2 years, or deleted sooner if you ask (tell us the email or wording you used).
Data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS), access is limited to what is needed, and the database uses row-level security.
You can ask to access, copy, correct, delete or move your data, object, restrict its use, or withdraw consent. See Your data rights.
You can complain to Thailand's Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC) if you believe we have broken the law.
We will post significant changes on the site before they take effect.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: PeelPlan keeps browser storage to a minimum and only uses what the site needs to work. We use no advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.h: What we store in your browser
p: Sign-in: authentication cookies that keep you logged in.
Your theme (light or dark) and language.
Layouts, uploaded sticker images and calibration, in your browser's localStorage and IndexedDB.
A random visit ID in sessionStorage, for the current tab only and erased when you close it. It lets us count visits without cookies and without knowing who you are.

sections.h: Why there is no consent banner
p: Everything above is either strictly necessary for the service you asked for or, for the visit ID, privacy-friendly first-party statistics with no cookies, nothing that identifies you and nothing that follows you to other sites, so it doesn't need separate consent. If your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, we skip the statistics completely. If we ever add advertising or third-party analytics cookies, we will ask first and you can say no.
You can clear this data in your browser settings, but the site may forget your sign-in or layouts.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using PeelPlan you agree to these terms.

p: PeelPlan helps you plan stickers on a MacBook lid at real size and creates a 1:1 PDF to print. Some lid measurements are estimates; check against your real device before sticking.
You must be 13 or older, and 20 or older to run a shop. You are responsible for activity under your account.
You must have the rights to images you upload. Do not upload content that infringes others' copyright or trademarks. We may remove content reported as infringing.
MacBook is a trademark of Apple Inc. PeelPlan is not affiliated with Apple. Shops marked as examples are placeholders and do not sell anything.

PeelPlan is a venue where independent shops list stickers. When you buy, the contract of sale is between you and the shop. PeelPlan is not a party to it, is not the seller, and does not guarantee a shop's products, delivery or conduct.
Sizes shown in millimetres come from the shop. Check them before you order.

You pay the shop directly by PromptPay to the account the shop provides, then upload your transfer slip. PeelPlan never receives or holds your money, so it cannot issue refunds, reverse transfers or release payments.
Before paying, check that the account name in your banking app matches the name shown on the order. Never pay to a different account sent to you in chat.
Refunds, returns and missing or damaged parcels are settled between you and the shop. If you cannot agree, you may contact your bank or the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB).
Report a shop or a conversation if something goes wrong. We may look at the order record and chat to help, but we do not decide disputes between buyers and shops.
We may hide listings, suspend or close shops and accounts that break these terms, receive repeated complaints, or appear to be fraudulent.
Counterfeit stickers, or designs that copy other people's characters, logos, artwork or trademarks without permission. Shops must own the rights to what they sell or hold a licence.
Anything illegal in Thailand, hateful, sexually explicit, or that encourages violence; personal data of other people; and anything that is not a sticker or a closely related accessory.
Use chat for questions and orders. No harassment, threats, spam, or attempts to move payment to unrelated accounts or links. Do not share other people's personal data.
Messages are visible to you and the shop. We may review a conversation when it is reported.
Shops can link to their pages on TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Instagram, Facebook or LINE. Purchases made there are governed by that platform's own terms and protections, not by PeelPlan.
We aim for ±1 mm accuracy, but results depend on your printer and settings. We are not liable for damage from applying stickers to your device.
These terms are governed by the laws of Thailand.

sellers.title: Seller terms
sellers.intro: These terms apply on top of the Terms of use when you open a shop on PeelPlan. By listing products you agree to them.

p: You must be 20 or older and give your real full name when you apply. Shops are reviewed before they go public, and changing your shop's name or description sends it back for review.
You sell as an independent business. You are the seller in every sale and are responsible for your own taxes, permits and consumer obligations.
Give accurate sizes in millimetres, finish and photos. Buyers plan their layouts from your measurements, so a sticker should match its listed size to within about 1 mm.
Keep stock honest. Set a quantity if you have limited stock, or leave it empty only for made-to-order items you can really produce.
Buyers pay you directly by PromptPay to the number and account name you set. Make sure both are correct and belong to you or your business.
Confirm a slip only after you see the money in your account, and reject it honestly if you don't. Never ask buyers to pay outside the order or to a different account.
PeelPlan does not collect, hold or pass on payments and charges no commission at this stage.
Ship within the time you state in your shop, add a tracking number when you can, and keep proof of postage.
If you cannot fulfil an order, cancel it and refund the buyer in full yourself. Refunds, returns and damaged parcels are handled directly between you and the buyer.
Use buyers' addresses, phone numbers and slips only to fulfil their orders. Do not keep them longer than you need, share them, or use them for marketing.
You confirm you own or are licensed to sell every design you list. No counterfeits, fan art of protected characters, or copied logos, artwork or trademarks.
We remove listings reported as infringing and may close shops after repeated reports.
We may hide listings, delist products, or suspend or close a shop that breaks these terms, receives repeated complaints, or appears fraudulent. Where possible we will tell you why.
You can close your shop at any time. Open orders must still be fulfilled or refunded.

pay.step3: Attach the slip below. The shop checks it and confirms your payment.

buyer.slipTitle: Slip sent, waiting for the shop
buyer.slipBody: The shop will check the amount and confirm. If the slip doesn't match, the order comes back here for a new one.
buyer.paidBody: They're getting it ready to ship. The tracking number shows here once it's sent.
buyer.shippedBody: Track it with the number below. Once it arrives, please confirm for the shop.
buyer.doneBody: Thanks for supporting this shop. Enjoy your stickers.

seller.waitingTitle: Waiting for the buyer to pay
seller.waitingBody: The buyer pays {amount} to your PromptPay and attaches the slip here.
seller.checkBody: Make sure {amount} actually arrived in your banking app before confirming (order {code}).
seller.rejectHint: "Slip doesn't match" sends the order back to awaiting payment so the buyer can attach a new slip.
seller.shipBody: Pack the order, then add the carrier and tracking number. The buyer sees it right away.
seller.shippedBody: Waiting for the buyer to confirm they received it.
seller.doneBody: The buyer confirmed they received it.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.body: This can't be undone. If money was already transferred, sort out the refund with the other side in chat.

errors.storage-full: This device's storage is full. Try a smaller image.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

admin.title: Admin
admin.testBody: Anyone signed in with the test account can open this page, and everything here comes from this browser only. On the live site, only accounts with is_admin = true in Supabase (profiles table) get in.
admin.loadError: Couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.
admin.saveError: Couldn't save that change. Try again.

denied.title: This page is for the PeelPlan team
denied.body: Your account doesn't have admin access. If you're on the team, ask an existing admin to turn it on for you.

overview.trafficNote: A visit is one browser tab on one day. Counted without cookies; people with Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control are not counted.
overview.trafficNoteTest: Test mode: these numbers only count visits made in this browser.

visitors.testNote: Test mode: these numbers only reflect visits made in this browser, so they will look small. On the live site every visitor is counted (except those with Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control).
visitors.emptyBody: Statistics appear here once people visit the site. Admin pages are never counted.
visitors.chartHint: Hover, tap or use the arrow keys for a day's numbers
visitors.chartLabel: Chart of daily visits and page views over {days} days. The numbers are also in the table below.
visitors.noReferrers: No visits from other websites yet. Direct visits and apps that hide the referrer aren't listed.

shops.emptyBody: New shop applications show up here for approval.
